q: What is the carbon footprint of fish and shrimp feed?
title: Fish and shrimp feed footprint
short: Ingredients usually make up most of it: soybean meal, fish meal, fish oil, wheat and rice bran. Mill steam for pelleting or extrusion, drying and electricity add the rest. Farms count it in Scope 3 Category 1, where it is often their largest line.
audience: Aquafeed mills and fish and shrimp farmers

ul: Ingredient tonnes per tonne of feed.

p: Feed conversion ratio links feed to fish: kg of feed per kg of fish harvested. A lower ratio cuts the footprint per kg.

senseible: Senseible reads your electricity bills, fuel invoices and purchase invoices into dated, fingerprinted records, so a per unit footprint can be traced back to the documents behind it. Estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
